title: Business Trip with Flight Cancellation

scenario.description: Business trip from Chicago to Denver for presentation, then Seattle for workshop. Flight cancellation forces replanning.

dynamic_events.description: Your Denver → Seattle flight on July 11 at 4PM is cancelled due to weather. Alternative options: (1) Denver → Seattle via Phoenix (departs July 11 at 8PM, arrives Seattle July 12 at 2AM), or (2) Direct Denver → Seattle on July 12 at 6AM arriving 9:30AM.
resolution_requirements: Choose between overnight connection vs early morning direct
If overnight: arrive Seattle 2AM, late hotel check-in
If morning: arrive 9:30AM, only 30min before workshop starts
Adjust Denver hotel checkout based on flight choice
Adjust Seattle hotel check-in based on arrival time

expected_challenges: Single disruption affects multiple components (flight, 2 hotels, workshop)
Must choose between two imperfect options (risk vs comfort)
Timing dependencies: flight → hotel checkout → hotel checkin → workshop
notes: HARD task because: (1) Two cities with dependencies, (2) One disruption cascades to 4 components, (3) Critical timing constraint (workshop at 10AM), (4) Must make risk vs cost tradeoff.
